Cooling checks on an eventful block
This section shows what is expected

Companion Animal Travel Desk - Animal Booking and Transfer Care

This section sets out the basic handling and recordkeeping steps for companion animal bookings and transfers at Aurelia Skyways. Please follow the process carefully so animal welfare stays central and customer guidance remains consistent.

Staff must use calm, low-stress handling and avoid any rough or rushed movement around animals. Crates, carriers, and transfer areas should be checked for secure latches, clean surfaces, and adequate ventilation before use. Staff should speak in a steady manner and keep noise low when assisting travelers such as Eva Mori or Yara Alvarez, and any pet such as Nibbles, so the animal is not unsettled. <<FACT F097>> The booking record must match the approved travel request, and any concern about condition, containment, or unusual behavior must be passed to the welfare coordinator without delay.

When an animal is moved between desk stages or service points, the required transfer paperwork must be complete and easy to read. <<FACT F088>> Staff should confirm that labels, carrier details, and care notes agree before releasing the animal from the current control point. If anything is unclear, the transfer must pause until the issue is settled, because apology is due when a process is not yet ready.

Records should be clear, factual, and limited to the service action taken. Do not make promises about animal comfort that cannot be supported by observation. If a traveler appears anxious, offer simple guidance and refer any welfare concern to the appropriate review path.

For questions or escalation, contact the senior coordinator or the welfare coordinator at Companion Animal Travel Desk.
